Flat two-dimensional cartoon. Exactly two anthropomorphic animal characters.
Cast: A is GAT, armilla blau fosc amb un triangle clar al davant; B is LLEÓ, samarreta ocre amb dues ratlles blanques al davant.
One cat and one lion at a simple counter, fixed view. P1 EXACTLY TWO large round copper coins already lie flat on a tiny pale saucer below the cat's clearly empty paw, which has just paid; lion holds the one elongated loaf with two pointed tips. P2 lion collects the SAME TWO coins from saucer toward a small plain cash dish while cat spreads open a plain paper bag, loaf lying on counter fully visible. P3 lion places that SAME loaf into bag held open by cat, two coins sit in dish. P4 cat holds bag with the two pointed bread tips visible ABOVE its rim (loaf inserted diagonally); lion rests empty paw by the cash dish containing the same two coins, saucer empty. No additional round objects or coins.
attempts.review: A la vinyeta 2 hi ha tres monedes: una a la mà del lleó i dues a la safata.

Flat two-dimensional cartoon. Exactly two anthropomorphic animal characters.
Cast: A is GAT, armilla blau fosc amb un triangle clar al davant; B is LLEÓ, samarreta ocre amb dues ratlles blanques al davant.
Same left cat in triangle vest buys a single golden loaf with one end forked into two points from same yellow-shirted lion at right. Use one simple empty blue SAUCER and only two coins, different colors and clearly visible; no other coin storage props. Panels arranged chronologically. P1 cat shows both palms at the edge of the counter, two coins already resting side-by-side on saucer, lion displays that loaf. P2 both coins remain RESTING FLAT untouched on the same saucer, cat uses BOTH PAWS to hold open a plain brown bag, lion rests loaf on countertop to prepare. P3 lion uses BOTH PAWS to slide the single loaf into the bag as cat holds the sides; both coins sit undisturbed on saucer. P4 lion holds the saucer with same two coins, cat carries bag with the loaf's forked tip protruding. No other objects. Clear identities, count two coins every panel, no extra coins in paws.
attempts.review: La mateixa peça de pa amb dues puntes passa a la bossa sostinguda pel gat. Les dues monedes, plata i or, sempre són al platet blau i el lleó el recull quan enllesteix l’encàrrec.

alt.ca: El gat paga dues monedes i obre la bossa. El lleó hi posa el pa de dues puntes i recull el platet amb les monedes.
alt.es: El gato paga dos monedas y abre la bolsa. El león mete el pan de dos puntas y recoge el platillo con las monedas.
